# Synthetic Fixtures Only

Every person, office, membership, policy role, official-source registration,
staff assignment, review, and evidence receipt in `synthetic.ts` is fabricated
for isolated contract tests. Reserved `.invalid` hosts cannot be real sources.

These fixtures do not qualify a source, prove any official's service, staff a
monitoring shift, or satisfy a launch requirement. Do not import them into the
application, bundled content, live ingestion, public API, or publication storage.
The county names and IDs are the actual pre-existing product geography; they are
tested for parity with the approved coverage pack and are not coverage claims.
